summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by Adamas Trust, Inc. for an at-the-market offering of up to $250 million of common stock. The filing establishes an equity distribution agreement with JonesTrading, BTIG, and B. Riley as agents. Shares will be sold at prevailing market prices (last reported price $9.11 on June 11, 2026) via ordinary brokers' transactions or block trades. The agents earn up to 2.0% compensation. This is a standard shelf takedown for capital raising, not a special situation. No deal terms apply as no specific transaction is announced beyond the continuous offering.
